# Sparvic

> Sparvic (sparvic.com) is Kolkata's pickleball community and sports platform. Members book daily open-play pickleball games, find and follow players at their level, book coaching and sports-clinic consultations, enter DUPR-rated tournaments, and buy pickleball gear, all from one free account.

## Key facts
- City: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- Sport: pickleball (singles and doubles; beginner to advanced)
- Daily games: partner venues across Kolkata (including New Alipore, Topsia and Ballygunge)
- Booking: members book slots from their Sparvic clubhouse; slots show venue, court number, level and spots left
- Coaching: group batches and sessions, including a monthly programme with coach Ishaan Chetani
- Player care: paid clinic consultations for pickleball injuries, pain and recovery
- Shop: Champion Series paddles, balls and accessories; guest checkout; pickup from a Sparvic venue or delivery across Kolkata
- Contact: info@sparvic.com, +91 91631 32551, Instagram @sparvic_official

## Sparvic Open Tournament
- Dates: 30 October – 1 November 2026
- Venue: TurfXL New Alipore, Kolkata
- Nine DUPR-banded categories: Men's Singles (< 3.599, < 4.099, < 4.599), Men's Doubles (< 3.599, < 4.299), Women's Doubles (< 3.599, < 4.099), Mixed Doubles (< 3.599, < 4.099)
- Entry fees: Rs 1,600 (singles), Rs 2,000 – 3,000 per doubles team
- Registration: online from the Sparvic clubhouse with Razorpay payment; members who joined before launch get 10% off
